ApplyPivotTo.description: Pivot application of pegs and skeletons (05 §2.3).

entry.description: Package entry path when embedded (`media/<assetId>.<ext>`); `null` when linked.

link.description: The link when linked; `null` when embedded.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the file bytes.

sourcePath.description: Where the file was imported from (informational).

Asset.description: The project-wide registry entry of one media file (10 §4.16).

oneOf.description: Vector file linked by media elements.

path.description: Files: path relative to the folder containing the project.

absolutePath.description: Files: absolute path at link time.

versionId.description: Library items: template version seen at link time (08 LIB-007).

AssetLink.description: The link of a `linked` asset (10 §4.16). Fields that do not apply to the link kind are `null`.

oneOf.description: Referenced in place (file or library item).

AxesTransform.description: A 2-D affine transform as axes and origin (06 §3.4 shadow transform).

size.description: Size in bytes (64-bit: entries larger than 4 GiB are supported, 10 §5).

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the bytes.

Blob.description: A binary payload stored as a package entry (10 §1.1). Never inlined in object JSON.

simulationStart.description: First simulated frame (≤ firstFrame, ≥ firstFrame − 999; may be < 1 for pre-roll).

maxParticles.description: Particle cap (≤ 3000; 50 for fog and cloud).

BlockStatic.description: Static parameters of a particle block (06 §3.8.3). Frames are absolute scene frames.

BoneInfluence.description: Zone of influence of a bone (05 §13.3).

keys.description: 1-D channels: keys sorted by frame, at least one.

points.description: Motion path: points in path order; first and last are keyframes.

inverted.description: Draw children outside the mask instead of inside.

Colour.description: sRGB colour with straight alpha, #RRGGBBAA (written upper case; #RRGGBB accepted on input).

ColourRecoveryEntry.description: A recovery copy of one swatch used by a drawing (10 §4.11, 03 §11.2).

oneOf.description: Bézier with an easing preset per segment.

rev.description: Revision of the last change (the drawing revision of 02 §3.12).

name.description: Unique in the bank; default next unused integer.

locked.description: Locked drawings reject content edits with `drawing.locked`.

mouthShape.description: Mouth shape for automatic lip-sync mapping.

colourRecovery.description: One entry per colour ID the drawing uses (written on save).

Drawing.description: A drawing (10 §4.8). Stored in its own package entry `banks/<bankId>/<drawingId>.json`.

drawings.description: Drawings (unordered; written in natural name order).

DrawingBank.description: The drawings of one clone group (10 §4.8). Stored in `banks/<bankId>/bank.json` with drawing stubs.

kind.description: Layer, group, text or bitmap; read-only.

children.description: Group: child nodes, back to front.

transform.description: Text and bitmap: placement in drawing space.

width.description: Text: wrap width in du (fixed mode); bitmap: pixel width 1–16384.

runs.description: Text: character runs covering the text.

image.description: Bitmap: PNG pixels (8-bit RGBA, straight alpha).

DrawingNode.description:
A node of a drawing (10 §4.9): a layer (`hint`, `strokes`), a group (`children`), a text object (`transform`,
`widthMode`, `width`, `text`, `runs`, `paragraphs`) or a bitmap (`image`, `width`, `height`, `transform`).
Properties of other kinds are absent.

parentColourTransformMode.description: How a parent Colour Transform applies.

keyframes.description: Keyframes sorted by frame, at least one.

DynamicParam.description: A dynamic block parameter: a constant `{value}` or `{keyframes}` (06 §8.4).

elementType.description: Element type; read-only except through conversion commands.

start.description: Non-cell elements: first frame of the bar (persisted). Cell-based elements: derived from the exposure (query results only).

duration.description: Non-cell elements: length of the bar (absent for cell-based elements: derived).

visibleInScene.description: Shown in scene views, playback and export.

visibleInXsheet.description: Cell-based elements: shown in the Exposure Sheet and Drawing View.

columnWidth.description: Exposure Sheet column width, 20–1000 view pixels.

drawingBankId.description: Cell-based: the drawing bank (shared by clones).

exposure.description: Cell-based: canonical exposure runs from frame 1.

showMouthShapes.description: Sound: the Exposure Sheet shows mouths.

lipSyncMappings.description: Sound: one mapping per mapped drawing element.

params.description: Effects: static parameter values (exact shape per `elementType`).

Element.description: An element of a scene (10 §4.5–§4.7). Stored in `scenes/<sceneId>/elements/<elementId>.json`.

oneOf.description: Effect parameter element (mask, sprites, bones, skin slot).

ElementType.description:
Element types (10 §4.5). The 04 read model reports this value as `type`; the object model uses `elementType`
(design decision D6).

EnvelopePoint.description: A gain point of a placement envelope (07 §9.5).

groupOnVectorExport.description: Group the subtree on vector export.

addComposite.description: Add a composite for the export group.

Ext.description: Extension data keyed by reverse-DNS namespace; unknown namespaces are preserved verbatim.

FrameValue.description: A `{frame, value}` keyframe of a dynamic block parameter.

GradientValue.description: `{stops}` with at least two stops sorted by position.

frame.description: Integer frame, unique in the channel.

constantSegment.description: The segment starting here holds the value.

easing.description: Easing preset of the segment starting here (interpolation curves).

Key.description: A key of a 1-D channel (10 §4.12). Addressed as `key:"<frame>"` or `key:@<id>`.

Library.description:
A library (10 §4.17). In the document this is the project-local library (`kind: "local"`), stored under
`library/library.json` in the package layout of 10 §6.11.

file.description: Stored file name relative to the library's `files/` folder.

versionId.description: Templates: version ID, changed whenever the content changes (08 LIB-007).

LibraryItem.description: A library item (10 §4.17). Template metadata (08 §6.3) is present for templates only.

LineStyle.description: Line style of a pencil stroke.

LineType.description: Line type of a pencil line style (02 §3.2; other types MAY be added).

autoReapply.description: Re-apply automatically when the track changes.

LipSyncMapping.description: A lip-sync mapping for one drawing element (10 §4.14).

oneOf.description: The cycle length is kept; cycles follow the duration.

linkOffset.description: Frame of the source shown at `startFrame`, ≥ 1.

MediaSequence.description: A run of frames of a media element showing one linked source (10 §4.15).

constantSegment.description: The segment starting at this keyframe holds the position.

lockDepth.description: Constant Z for the segment starting here (05 §9.3).

MotionPoint.description: A point of a motion path (10 §4.12): a keyframe (`frame` set) or a control point (`frame: null`).

MouthMapping.description: Which drawing represents each mouth shape (07 §10.8).

mouths.description: One letter (`A`–`G`, `X`) per frame of the placement.

manual.description: Placement-relative frame ranges set by hand or explicitly.

labels.description: Optional display labels, keyed by placement-relative frame.

MouthTrackSource.description: How a mouth track was produced (10 §4.14).

styles.description: Styles in order; at least one.

swatches.description: Swatches in user order; may be empty.

hidden.description: Internal palette never shown to the user (03 §1.2; SI-005).

PaletteStyle.description: A palette style: an alternative set of values for all swatches of its palette (03 §1.5).

Paragraph.description: Paragraph formatting of a text node (10 §4.9).

ParentColourTransformMode.description: How an inherited Colour Transform applies to a Drop Shadow (06 §3.4).

dynamic.description: Dynamic parameters by id (exactly the ids of 06 §3.8.4).

ParticleBlock.description: A simulation block of a particle effect (10 §4.6, 06 §3.8.2, §8.4).

ParticleParams.description: Particle effects have no effect-level parameters; their content is in `blocks` (06 §3.8).

ParticleType.description: Particle types (06 §3.8.1). Persisted as `particleType` because `type` is the envelope field (SI-004).

rev.description: Revision of the last change (10 REV-02).

minSize.description: Width at lowest pressure, 0–100 du; `minSize ≤ maxSize`.

smoothness.description: Curve-fitting tolerance and pressure smoothing, 0–10 (10 §4.2: int).

tipAngle.description: Orientation of non-round tips, 0–360 degrees (02 §6.1; SI-004).

colourId.description: Colour bound to the pen; `null` = use the current colour.

Pen.description: A pen preset (10 §4.2). Unique name in the project.

oneOf.description: Used by the Brush (and Pencil/shape thickness).

PenKind.description: Tool family of a pen (02 §6.1 "Type"). Persisted as `kind` because `type` is the envelope field (SI-004).

oneOf.description: Every cycle restarts from the first position.
Cycles advance by the first cycle's displacement.

ProducedFor.description: The timing a mouth track was produced for (10 §4.14).

name.description: Project name; default `Untitled`; also the default package file stem.

frameRate.description: Frames per second, 1–120; NTSC rates are exact as written.

autoColourUpdate.description: Whether template swatch values overwrite project values with the same colour IDs (03 §1.2; SI-005).

startTransition.description: Edit point before the first scene.

palettes.description: Palettes in display order; at least one.

drawingBanks.description: Drawing banks (unordered; written in ID order).

scenes.description: Scenes in storyline order; at least one.

Project.description:
The project (10 §4.1). Stored in `project.json` with stubs of palettes, drawing banks, scenes and the local
library.

RecoveryStyle.description: A style reference inside a colour-recovery entry.

oneOf.description: In front of all normal elements.
Behind all normal elements; auto-extends to the scene length.

Role.description: Composite role (04 §6.1, 05 §8.1; SI-003: the superset of 04/05 and 10 §4.5).

Scale2.description: A 2-D scale `{x, y}`; `|s| ≥ 0.001`, negative values flip.

visible.description: Hidden scenes are skipped by storyline playback and export.

currentCameraId.description: The current camera; must be a camera of this scene when it has one.

paletteStyles.description: Active style per palette: exactly one entry per palette, in palette order.

tree.description: Timeline order and hierarchy; every element exactly once.

columnOrder.description: Exposure Sheet order of the cell-based elements, back to front.

elements.description: The elements (unordered; written in ID order).

Scene.description: A scene (10 §4.3). Stored in `scenes/<sceneId>/scene.json` with element stubs.

Script.description: Vertical script position of a text run.

Sides.description: Fills on the left and right side of a stroke, relative to point order.

assetId.description: A `sound` asset, or a `movie` asset with audio.

SoundPlacement.description: One use of a sound asset in a sound element (10 §4.14, 07 §1.2).

pressure.description: Pressure map: `(t, p)` samples ordered by `t`.

Spine.description: The spine of an unedited brush stroke (02 §3.2).

penId.description: The pen used, if it still exists.

SpinePen.description: The pen recorded on a brush spine (02 §3.2).

closed.description: Whether the path is closed (brush outlines are).

points.description: Anchors with handle offsets; at least 2 (1 for a closed dab).

colourId.description: Brush: fill colour; pencil: line colour; `null` for invisible strokes.

fillMatrix.description: Placement of a gradient/texture colour space for brush strokes.

Stroke.description:
A stroke of a layer (10 §4.9, 02 §3.2). `lineStyle` is non-null for pencil strokes only; `spine` only for
unedited brush strokes.

oneOf.description: Centre line drawn with a line style.
Never rendered; separates and closes zones.

Stub.description: A stub standing for an object that is not expanded (10 §2.2). A stub has no `rev`.

colourId.description: Immutable colour ID, unique across the project.

kind.description: Solid, gradient or texture; shared by all styles.

deformable.description: Whether a gradient/texture fill follows bone deformation (03 §7.5).

values.description: Exactly one value per style of the palette, keyed by style ID, in style order.

Swatch.description: A swatch (03 §1.4, §12.3). Its identifier field is `colourId` (10 §2.2); `id` is accepted as an alias on input.

anyOf.description: A gradient (linear or radial; the swatch `kind` says which).

SwatchValue.description: The value of a swatch in one style (03 §12.3): `{rgba}`, `{stops}` or `{image, tile}`.

TemplateSummaryNode.description: A node of a template's element-tree summary (08 §6.3).

font.description: Font family name (kept even when the font is missing).

TextRun.description: Character formatting of a run of a text node (10 §4.9).

image.description: Package entry path of the image, e.g. `textures/fabric-day.png`.

tile.description: Repeat the image (true) or stretch it over the zone (false).

TextureValue.description: `{image, tile}`: a texture image entry (under `textures/`) and the tile flag; `width`/`height` informative.

keepProportions.description: Keep the scale ratio when editing one value.

rotateAboutPivot.description: Elements: rotate about the rotation pivot.

applyPivotTo.description: Pegs and skeletons: what the pivot applies to.

useChildDrawingPivot.description: Pegs: use the child drawing's pivot.

lockDepth.description: Constant Z for nodes with a motion path (05 §9.3).

Transform.description:
The static transform block (10 §4.6, 05 §1.5, §8). Pivot fields depend on the element type: drawing, annotation,
image and media elements have `rotationPivot`, `scalePivot`, `rotateAboutPivot`; pegs have `pivot`,
`applyPivotTo`, `useChildDrawingPivot`; skeletons have `pivot`, `applyPivotTo`; cameras have none (ADR-0010).

angle.description: Angle for wipe, slide and clock wipe, 0–360 degrees (default 0).

direction.description: Direction for slide and clock wipe; `null` until a type that uses it is chosen.

Transition.description:
A transition at an edit point: `project.startTransition` or a scene's `outTransition` (10 §4.4). Fields not
used by the current type are kept so that switching back restores them.

TransitionType.description: Transition type (08 §13.1). Persisted as `transitionType` because `type` is the envelope field (SI-004).

children.description: Children, top to bottom as displayed in the Timeline.

TreeNode.description: A node of the scene tree: `{id, children}` (10 §4.3).

WidthMode.description: Width mode of a text node.

ZoneFill.description: The fill of the zone on one side of a stroke (10 §4.9).
